explanation: Starting at x=0.5 with v=0.5 outward plus theta/omega leaning outward, the state-feedback controller (force ~0.5N, far below 40N limit) prioritizes pole balance (theta stays ~0.067 rad, margin ~0.73) over cart centering, allowing steady cart drift (~1.3-1.37 m/s) until it exits the 2.4m track at step 95. Likely cause: controller gains weight pole stabilization too weakly penalizing cart position, so initial outward momentum is never reversed.
